#panel: cwu50 = uConsole 5in 720x1280 newer batch, cwu50_old = same glass original batch, cwd686 = DevTerm 6.86in 480x1280
#panel2: cwu50 and cwu50_old are two hardware batches with identical timings but mutually exclusive DDIC init tables; pick the one matching your screen, neither is auto-detected
#contrast: dev.cmd ct [up|down|20-300] only takes effect at depth 16; at depth 32 the zero-copy flush path cannot carry the LUT
